expected_issues.title: **BUG: Potential Null Return Not Handled**
When a DBCException is caught, it's only logged but not re-thrown
expected_issues.description: When a DBCException is caught, it's only logged but not re-thrown. This silently swallows the exception and makes the caller believe the operation succeeded. This could lead to inconsistent state where the super class catalog is set but activeCatalogName remains null. Consider re-throwing the exception after logging, or at minimum setting activeCatalogName to null to indicate the catalog was not properly set.

known_false_positives.description:
When initializing the context state from an existing context (`initFrom`), only the default catalog is copied. Since Databricks supports schemas (databases), the default schema should also be propagated to ensure the new context maintains the same active scope. 

Consider retrieving the default schema from `executionMetaContext` and passing it to `setDefaultCatalog`. Note that you will need to import `org.jkiss.dbeaver.ext.generic.model.GenericSchema`.
